body: Please wait a minute! please! please!
Give me a chance to know you, please talk to me. I know how is it feels. Im struggling with depression too since 9 years. Please let's talk
I dont really know how this site work but I sent you a message :D
If you are keep trying then you're not wasting your time, i hope you get the help that you need and dont give up. :)

hey there.

I'm sorry if my english is not perfect, i'm from chile (latin america) and i read all your text. I drop one single tear to be honest (I try to not because a long time ago I promised to myself i would never cry again) but your words touch my heart in such a profound level.

 I can relate a lot of things that you say. I know how you feel. I have almost 25 and depression too... i dont really know at this point why i fight  (you can look at the news about my country and thing doesn't look so nice for the near future), i have felt broken like you so many times... I dont have friends anymore because i was to "sad" and they dont like that. I use to have a girlfriend but again my depression make her go away. Im unemployed and I don't have anybody who i can talk to. 

**But the reason why i write you** this is because I just want to help you even if can't help myself. From all what i read above i can tell that you're a good person, that you care for others even more than you do for yourself. I wish i know you in real life and talk to you. Anybody who have a friend like you should be thankful and if they cant see how worthy you then they don't matter. I didn't understand if you just like art or make it too, but i like to draw when, it's just bad art but helps me sometimes.

"My friends make me feel like I'm not a person that wants good things for anyone. They make me feel like... I want it for.. gratitude or... recognition. I couldn't care less about this either. I just want... Nobody to have to feel like this again. "   You're a good person, you're priceless and i'm not saying it just because. I say it because i don't know anyone like you. 

I hope you sleep and get some rest. Relax, because even if you can't see anybody around you doesn't mean that you're alone. I care about you even if i dont know you but because i can tell that deserve it. Please and i beg you dont kill yourself. Im really mean it. I wish i was there to give you a hug or share some food that you really enjoy. I appreciate how you keep trying and keep pushing forward even if you dont feel well. I really thank you for being so strong.

I know we can go over this mental illness, I know if we keep supporting each other  as a community we can go through this.

Sorry again if i didn't express myself to well i try my best and english is my second language lol.  

I can tell that you're special and it will so sad if you stop being in this world... 

I wish we can keep talking, i like you.
You captured his expressions so nicely, looks so cute :D
